answer.says: You are right, Shri Hegde. The procedure is the procedure, and I am the one who must wait for it. I shall leave you to your sleep.
answer.thought: His refusal is the shape of the bureaucracy itself: a closed system that does not answer to the individual but only to its own internal logic. I am tired, and the raita is indeed waiting. I will go.
